facts.default_credentials: Are any devices still using default/factory login credentials?
facts.no_firewall: Is there no firewall (or an unconfigured firewall) protecting the network?
facts.open_ports: Are there open ports exposed directly to the internet?
facts.unencrypted_traffic: Is sensitive traffic sent without encryption (e.g. plain HTTP, FTP)?
facts.outdated_firmware: Is any router/switch/firewall firmware out of date?
facts.weak_wifi_encryption: Is the wifi using weak or no encryption (open, WEP, or WPA)?
facts.no_network_segmentation: Are all devices on a single flat network with no segmentation/VLANs?
facts.unrestricted_remote_access: Is remote access (RDP/SSH/VPN) allowed from any IP with no restrictions?
facts.no_logging_monitoring: Is there no logging or monitoring of network/security events?
facts.guest_network_shared: Does the guest wifi share the same network as internal systems?
facts.popup ads: Are users seeing unexpected pop-up ads on their machines?

recommendation: Change all default usernames/passwords immediately.
Enforce a password policy for all network devices.
Audit devices periodically for default credentials.
Deploy and configure a firewall with a default-deny inbound policy.
Close any ports not explicitly required.
Restrict remaining open ports to known source IPs where possible.
Enforce TLS/HTTPS and SFTP/SSH for all sensitive traffic.
Disable legacy unencrypted protocols where possible.
Patch/update firmware on all network devices.
Subscribe to vendor security advisories.
Establish a regular patch-management schedule.
Switch to WPA3 (or WPA2-AES minimum).
Rotate wifi passwords and disable WPS.
Segment the network with VLANs by function/sensitivity.
Apply inter-VLAN access control rules.
Restrict remote access to a VPN with MFA.
Whitelist source IPs where feasible.
Disable direct RDP/SSH exposure to the internet.
Enable logging on firewalls, routers, and critical servers.
Centralize logs and set alerting for anomalies.
Put the guest network on its own isolated VLAN.
Block guest-to-internal traffic entirely.
